interface.signature: calculate_dominant_indices(n: int, edges: List[Tuple[int, int]]) -> List[int]

preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= x, y <= n and x != y for all edges (x, y) in edges
preconditions.description: Each edge in the tree connects two distinct vertices within the range of vertex indices.

preconditions.expression: The given edges form a tree
preconditions.description: The input edges are sufficient to form a single, connected tree without any cycles.

postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly n numbers, one for each vertex in the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result[i] < i for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each number in the output list is a valid index, representing the dominant index of the corresponding vertex.

postconditions.expression: result[i] is the dominant index of vertex i+1 for all i in range(n)
postconditions.description: The output list correctly identifies the dominant index for each vertex in the tree.
